verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a publishable, hosted Trust Center for prospects and customers, with custom domain and branding. Visitors can self-serve or request sensitive security documents, and admins can approve or deny requests, enforce an NDA, and choose which content to show or hide. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of live/real-time control status on the public page, explicit listing of certifications/reports as Trust Center content, confirmation the NDA is a click-through rather than admin-gated approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it shortens security reviews.
